About the Venice Electric Light Parade group ride

A weekly lit-up night ride along Venice Beach. Any human- or electric-powered ride is welcome, no gas vehicles. Family friendly, no smoking or drinking. Bring lights; wheel lights are not required.

It's a no-drop ride. If you're slower than the group, someone waits. That's the whole point of a group ride.
